raw.buffDescription: The Defender has 99% [k=glossary/energy_res]Energy Resistance[/k], and any Hit that deals Energy Damage Regenerates them for what the damage would have been. While the Defender is affected by an Incinerate, Shock, or [k=glossary/coldsnap]Coldsnap[/k] Debuff, the Defender gains 100% of a Bar of Power every 10 second(s).
